notes.title: Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly - Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/72e22fdc98cf290d6358d8e0bc50e8b7edb64add.png[/img]

[h3][b]Do you enjoy a relaxing story with distinctive urban fantasy characters? [/b][/h3]

[b][i]From the creators of A Space for the Unbound and When the Past was Around, and Coffee Talk.[/i][/b] Comes a sequel of the beloved heart-to-heart simulator, Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly. Take a role as a Barista in Coffee Talk, a coffee shop in the corner of an alternate Seattle with many regulars coming to relax and reconnect over a warm brew of classic (or unique) drinks. 

[i]Check out the release trailer here! [/i]
[previewyoutube=q4s5M28J1gU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly is the sequel to the hit release Coffee Talk. The game features new characters, mechanics to tell more exciting stories, and more colorful drinks to serve. [/b]Reconnect with the old and new characters of Coffee Talk, where everyone has their tales to tell during their regular visit. Become the Barista who hears about different problems, serves a drink that soothes the situation, and learns more about what's happening a few years after the original Coffee Talk. 

[h3][b]The game is OUT NOW; you can grab them here! [/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663220/Coffee_Talk_Episode_2_Hibiscus__Butterfly/

[h3][i][b]Do you want to experience the cozy Coffee Talk vibes fully? 
Check out the prequel, Coffee Talk, where it all begins! [/b][/i][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/914800/Coffee_Talk/

[b][i]If you are a huge fan of the story-focused game, love to hear relatable stories, or love a cup of warm drinks after a long day, we recommend trying out the game. [/i][/b]

Wish us luck, and may many enjoy the release of Coffee Talk Episode 2. We want to thank you, as without your continuous support, we won't reach the point we are right now. Please keep supporting us, and we look forward to more of our game releases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/6d12d226d450fe31f4e877fda10f3255c6426ca6.png[/img]
Stay safe and healthy, friends!

Mojiken and Toge Productions team.

[i][b]Opening new chapters in new languages, we also have some great news from Loka City.[/b][/i]

[h2]A Space for the Unbound Localization Update[/h2]
[b]A Space for the Unbound is now available in more languages, where you can play the game in in the list of updated localization which you can check out from the steam page.[/b] Almost two months after the release, the first additional localization update is here, and we hope it's the best version of how we can tell the stories in more languages. Feel free to play the game or tell your friends or loved ones waiting to try the game out in your local tongue. 

[h2]A Space for the Unbound is on Steam Sale[/h2]
[b]Get your copy of A Space for the Unbound 20% OFF this Spring Sale.[/b] The opportunity has presented itself with this sale, as you can get the game at a discounted price. Experience the entirely hand-drawn pixelated art of A Space for the Unbound with its colorful and touching stories that are perfect for everyone to enjoy. Even better, you can get the game for your friends or families looking for a distinctive, emotional narrative experience.

[h2]A Space for the Unbound in [i]"The Stories We Love"[/i] Bundle[/h2]

[i]"The Stories We Love"[/i] game bundle features top-rated narrative games. During this Spring Sale, you can grab the bundle for a great discount or complete the collection at a great price if you own some of these games.

👉 Coffee Talk: 95% overwhelmingly positive! 
👉 A Space for the Unbound: 98% overwhelmingly positive! 
👉 OPUS: Echo of Starsong: 97% overwhelmingly positive! 
👉 Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery: 96% overwhelmingly positive! 

[h2]Grab and Play A Space for the Unbound Now[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_for_the_Unbound/

[i]If you have encountered any problems with the new localization update, please get in touch with us on the Steam Discussion, or join our [url=discord.gg/toge]Discord community[/url] for faster inquiries. [/i]

notes.title: Trading Cards Now Available and Over 1,000 Positive Reviews on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/7167aaa7a7bc65980143514bc6d9568752075ae9.png[/img]

[h3]Hello, Space Divers![/h3]
[b][i]It's finally here! Rejoice for all the Divers who have been waiting for it.[/i][/b]

[h2]Trading cards are now available![/h2]

[b] A Space for the Unbound trading cards are now available on Steam. [/b]You can unlock and earn trading cards, level up your badge, and get A Space for the Unbound community items of emoticons and profile backgrounds. You can get up to three random trading cards by accumulating your playtime as you explore Loka City.

You can obtain and complete the six character trading cards consisting of A Space for the Unbound casts. If you have difficulty obtaining the rest of the cards, you can craft them and upgrade the level badge to display them on your Steam profile. The level badge also will change as you level up, showing the iconic flower bloom from the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/5444900f2a9fb3f324209df6bb0dac809d3fdb6d.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/9cf52141a185c383b07056b45d0ab0ab25c66131.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/b6e6b04326379ff4fc462d0bb02ee79440f5dda8.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/d110370317241bde55b8b477c1052e589b90cac0.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/6d12d226d450fe31f4e877fda10f3255c6426ca6.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/bc2fae5cc4114b67b031b3b86598fcae03d054bc.png[/img]
[i]Spread your love for A Space for the Unbound and show how much of a Space Diver you are to your friends and community! [/i]

[h2]Thank you for the overwhelmingly positive feedback. [/h2]
[b]In less than a month, A Space for the Unbound has passed 1,000 user reviews with an overwhelmingly positive rating on Steam.[/b] We can't believe the game would receive this much attention in such a short period. We want to thank everyone for supporting us so far and your feedback and kind words are why we are working hard to make better games in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/0c2d083091f41f9ecd5b4e17da102ecfcf77d780.jpg[/img]
[i]A full image from one of the trading cards, featuring Nirmala. [/i]

We are also delighted with the responses from everyone around the world. We received so many of them and it is truly a wonderful thing to know our game resonates with many people out there. Please keep supporting us for the rest of the year as more surprises are coming for each of you. 

How's your journey in Loka City so far? So many stories to explore, new people to meet, mysteries to solve, and a to-do list to finish. There are so many activities around town that keep you busy. Would you visit the town just for a day? 

[h3] You can grab the game here, and we would love to hear your feedback[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

Stay safe and healthy, friends!

Mojiken and Toge Productions team.

notes.title: A Space for the Unbound Community Broadcast, Featured at LudoNarraCon 2022!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/1ebb21553a8ed05bdb477ce83d5a677fb63403b2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello, Space Divers![/h3]

We are excited to announce that A Space for the Unbound will participate in LudoNarraCon 2022! LudoNarraCon is an annual digital convention, made by our friends at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/fellowtraveller]Fellow Traveler[/url], for developers and players who are into narrative video games. Please look at the indie exhibitor's with their selected games, including special coverages and new updates for many current and upcoming narrative games!

This event hopes to recreate the benefits of physical conventions online since the pandemic is not over yet. With many indie developers and publishers working together, we at Toge Productions are happy to become a part of this excellent online convention.

[b]The event will lasts for a few days, starting from May 5 (10 AM PT) to May 9 (09.59 AM PT)[/b]. Check the full line-up of the exhibitors [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com/]here[/url], you might discover unique narrative games to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/e3c193e59bd758edf59ebe35894f90a8dfee8b08.png[/img]
[i]Featuring over 40 game exhibitors, be sure to check them all out! [/i]

[h3]Join our Steam Community Broadcast![/h3]
[b]A Space for the Unbound will be live with a pre-recorded broadcast on May 8th at 9 PM PT.[/b] Mark the date and time so you tune in and join us to play the game together! Join Kashuur and Hak on this special community broadcast, where they will be playing the game together and explaining some stuff that are shown in the game! It will also be featured on A Space for The Unbound steam page. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36262819/ee374a8a858bb7c17517ddd98ed4fd2dba5eb9bf.jpg[/img] 

You can also play the new demo version from the full game steam page, which is packed with more content until the first few parts of Chapter 1. You can freely roam some city areas, and more hand-drawn pixel cutscenes are added in! Be sure to wishlist the game so you will be informed about any upcoming updates. 

The release date will be not so far away in 2022, so stay tuned!

[h3]Don't forget to wishlist A Space for the Unbound![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

Stay safe and healthy, friends!

Mojiken and Toge Productions team.
